{{Top|leg}}
A '''contributing sponsor''' was one of the corporations that invested in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Contributing sponsors invested less than a [[voting sponsor]]s, usually in the region of fifty trillion [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in currency, services, or equipment. They were also not guaranteed a voting position on the [[Executive Directorship Board]]. One-third of the voting seats of the Board were given to contributing sponsors, and the [[Direx]] members from the contributing sponsors were chosen from their number.
